audit.why: Difficulty 8.5/10 HARD matches a 49.24% win rate, and the shipped chart (Olaf 4 / Skill 3 / K'Sante 0) is coherent with it — Olaf owns levels 1-3 with Undertow poke and Reckless Swing, the 4-5 and 6 windows are genuinely even, and he keeps the item stages because true damage ignores what you build. Full and content layers already agree row for row, so no flip is proposed. The packet chart is more optimistic than the win rate supports and is not followed.

Spike order is right and unusually well-labelled: Olaf level 1, your level-3 full kit, his Ragnarok at 6, and his 2-item true-damage window. Ragnarok is 100/90/80 against All Out's 120/100/80 — his ultimate comes back faster at every rank, which is why the level-6 row is a coinflip rather than yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. (1) 'his true damage ignores your E shield' appears twice — true damage is not shield-piercing; Footwork's shield absorbs it like any other damage. The reason Ragnarok beats you is that it makes him immune to disables, not that it beats shields. (2) 'Q3 knockup' three times — Ntofo Strikes slows and PULLS on its second stack; Path Maker (W) is the knock-back and stun. (3) tldr and report[0] advertise '%HP true'. Reckless Swing is flat true damage in Riot's text ('deals true damage to his target and himself'), with no percent-health component and no percentHealth flag in the kit.
audit.why: Each one changes a build or commit decision: whether your shield is worth casting into him, what your Q actually does to him, and whether stacking health is a counter to his E.
audit.corrected: Ragnarok makes Olaf immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking (100/90/80s) and also passively grants him armour and MR — your Path Maker stun and Ntofo Strikes pull simply do not apply while it is up; Footwork's shield still absorbs Reckless Swing (325 range, 11/10/9/8/7s, paid in health not mana). Undertow is 9s at 1000 range and its cooldown RESETS if he picks the axe up.

audit.why: The page already names the right punishable window and the axe-pickup reset, which is the real cooldown lever in this lane: dodging Undertow so he cannot retrieve it keeps a 9s cooldown at 9s instead of near-zero.

edits.before: Levels 3 to 5 are your window. W-charge when he commits to a trade — the longer the charge the longer the stun against a wall — then Q3 to knock him up and stick your cleave. Your bulk lets you win the short exchange around his Reckless Swing self-damage, so trade in bursts and back off before his axe slow and lifesteal grind you down in an extended fight. At 6 it flips to a coinflip: his Ragnarok (R) makes him CC-immune and ignores your E shield with true damage, so do NOT bet a fight on landing your W stun into an Olaf who can simply pop R and walk through it.
edits.after: Levels 3 to 5 are your window. Charge Path Maker when he commits — the longer the charge, the longer the stun into a wall — then take your second Q stack to pull him back and stick the cleave. Your bulk wins short exchanges around Reckless Swing's self-damage, so trade in bursts and back off before his axe slow and his missing-health lifesteal grind you down. At 6 it flips to a coinflip: Ragnarok makes him immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking, so never bet a fight on landing your W stun into an Olaf still holding R.
